name: notesync-distributed-system
description: NoteSync - Distributed Student Notes Sharing System for FA-1 & FA-2 Assessment

scripts.start:nodes: concurrently "npm run start:node-ce" "npm run start:node-it" "npm run start:node-etc"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n "GATEWAY,NODE-CE,NODE-IT,NODE-ETC,CLIENT" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:node-ce" "npm run start:node-it" "npm run start:node-etc" "npm run start:client"
